I was driving home when traffic ahead slowed suddenly. I braked as firmly as I could, but the car behind me did not
stop in time and struck the rear of my vehicle. The impact pushed my car forward and jolted everyone inside. On 14
Dec 2024, near the main interesction in Pearland, I was riding with three passengers in the back and front seats. All
